Theorem
[Parallel-spinor manifolds (Theorem 35.8)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0305 1. ch35:35.8\group Linear Stability

If a compact Riemannian manifold is covered by a spin manifold admitting a nonzero parallel spinor, then $\Delta _L$ has nonpositive spectrum.
